chunks: A man from the people of the desert, who had servants and camels, came to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and said:

O Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, inform me about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: «Those who believe and used to have taqwa—for them is the glad tidings in the life of this world and in the Hereafter.»

He said: «As for His saying, “For them is the glad tidings in the life of this world,” it is the good vision which the believer sees, and by it he is given glad tidings in his worldly life. And as for the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, “and in the Hereafter,” then it is the glad tidings of the believer at death: he is given glad tidings at the time of his death that Allah has indeed forgiven you and those who carry you to your grave.»

key_terms.آمَنُوا: those who believed with true faith
key_terms.الرُّؤْيَا الْحَسَنَةُ: a good dream through which a believer receives glad tidings
key_terms.الْبُشْرَىٰ: glad tidings or good news promised by Allah to the believers
key_terms.الْمَوْتِ: the moment of death when the believer is given glad tidings
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنُ: the believer who receives divine reassurance
key_terms.غَفَرَ: forgave; indicating Allah’s pardon and mercy
key_terms.قَبْرِكَ: your grave, referring to burial after death
key_terms.يَتَّقُونَ: those who practice taqwa and remain God-conscious

ai.seo_question: What does the Qur'anic promise of glad tidings in this world and the Hereafter mean for believers?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic promise of glad tidings for the believers who have taqwa. In this world, it is understood as the righteous dream seen by the believer, and in the Hereafter, it is the good news given at death of Allah’s forgiveness. The report links faith and taqwa with comfort, reassurance, and divine mercy at life’s end.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.353 - A man from the Bedouins, who had servants and camels, came to the Messenger of Allah (sw) and said:

"O’ Messenger of Allah (sw), inform me about the words of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious: 'Those who believe and are conscious of Allah (swt) — they will have good news in this world and in the Hereafter' (Surah Yunus 10:63-64)

The Prophet replied: "As for His words, 'They will have good news in this world,' it refers to the good dreams that a believer sees and is given glad tidings by them in this world. And as for 'and in the Hereafter,' it refers to the glad tidings a believer receives at the time of death, that Allah (swt) has forgiven you and those who carry you to your grave."
